text.en: Dynand Fariz’s fashion house in Jember was a precursor to the carnival.
text.zh-TW: Dynand Fariz 在 Jember 創立的時裝工作室，是嘉年華的前身。

text.en: Dynand Fariz experimented with a themed fashion week with staff before the public carnival developed.
text.zh-TW: 在公開嘉年華形成之前，Dynand Fariz 曾與員工試行主題時裝週。

text.en: Two numbered editions took place in the first year. The debut coincided with Jember’s anniversary, and the second joined the Tajemtra walk.
text.zh-TW: 首年舉行兩屆有編號的嘉年華。首屆適逢 Jember 紀念活動，第二屆配合 Tajemtra 健走。

text.en: The third edition continued to develop the street format. Early retrospective sources describe a shift from the fashion house to a formal carnival organization; its exact legal naming and founding sequence require archival verification.
text.zh-TW: 第三屆持續發展街頭形式。早期回顧資料指出，主辦逐漸由時裝工作室轉向正式嘉年華組織；確切法人名稱與成立沿革仍待查證。

text.en: Eyes on Triumph marked the first decade by revisiting groups from earlier editions. Contemporary reporting also documents the 3.6 km street runway.
text.zh-TW: Eyes on Triumph 重訪前幾屆的分隊，紀念首個十年。當時報導也記載了 3.6 公里的街頭伸展臺。

text.en: The organizer lists an appearance at the 2015 Silk Road and Cultural Festival in Korea among JFC’s overseas activities.
text.zh-TW: 主辦方將 2015 年在韓國絲路文化節的亮相列入 JFC 的海外活動。

text.en: Indonesia’s tourism portal records JFC representing Indonesia at the International Carnaval de Victoria in Seychelles and placing third there.
text.zh-TW: 印尼旅遊官方網站記載，JFC 代表印尼參與塞席爾的 International Carnaval de Victoria，並於該活動獲第三名。

text.en: Historical reporting places Jember’s recognition as a carnival city in 2017.
text.zh-TW: 歷史報導將 Jember 獲嘉年華城市肯定的時間列於 2017 年。

text.en: Fariz died on April 17. The 18th edition went ahead, and Anne Avantie presented designs. Retrospective reporting records Budi Setiawan succeeding Fariz as JFC president.
text.zh-TW: Fariz 於 4 月 17 日逝世。第 18 屆仍如期舉辦，Anne Avantie 展出設計。回顧報導記載 Budi Setiawan 接任 JFC 主席。

text.en: During COVID-19 JFC participated in a virtual World Kids Carnival. It is listed separately from the numbered Grand Carnival editions.
text.zh-TW: COVID-19 疫情期間，JFC 參與線上 World Kids Carnival。此活動與有編號的主遊行分開記錄。

text.en: Virtue Fantasy was presented under pandemic restrictions.
text.zh-TW: Virtue Fantasy 在疫情限制下舉行。

text.en: The Legacy marked the return of a fully outdoor Grand Carnival. The organizer also records an Indonesia National Day appearance in Dubai in 2022.
text.zh-TW: The Legacy 標誌全戶外主遊行回歸。主辦方也記載 2022 年於杜拜印尼國慶活動亮相。

text.en: Timelapse explored Earth’s history. The tourism ministry records JFC in the Top 10 of its 2023 Karisma Event Nusantara program.
text.zh-TW: Timelapse 探索地球歷史。觀光部門記載 JFC 入列 2023 年 Karisma Event Nusantara 十大活動。

text.en: The August 4 Grand Carnival ended the Algorithm edition. Jember Regency documented ten defiles.
text.zh-TW: 8 月 4 日主遊行為 Algorithm 一屆收尾；地方政府記載十支分隊。

text.en: Evoluxion, edition 23, concluded on August 10 after a three-day program.
text.zh-TW: Evoluxion 為第 23 屆，三日活動於 8 月 10 日落幕。

text.en: The 24th edition used a Gaia-centered stage drama and a HEAL street parade in its July 26 Grand Carnival.
text.zh-TW: 第 24 屆於 7 月 26 日主遊行中安排以 Gaia 為主的舞臺劇，以及 HEAL 街頭隊列。
